scientific_integrity: All mathematical ingredients are attributed; computations are finite checks, not proofs of infinite claims; no external independent validation has been claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proof uses Uezato 2026 Theorem 1.3 as a published premise. It establishes only a near-exponential single-relation lower bound for ordinary FO3 formulas; it does not solve the open fully exponential, positive-fragment, or one-quantifier fixed-vocabulary questions. Priority against all older encodings has not been independently certified.
title: A near-exponential three-variable succinctness gap over one binary relation
